verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents its own official SDKs for browser, iOS, Android, Node.js and other platforms, but they cover only Events ingestion (instrumenting apps to send identify/track/page events). The management surface (syncs, models, sources, destinations) is exposed only as a REST API with an OpenAPI spec, not as official client SDKs. missing for 10: official SDKs for the management/REST API (syncs, models, audiences), SDK reference depth beyond the event-collection listing, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Hightouch provides SDKs for browser, iOS, Android, Node.js, and other platforms, plus an HTTP API for server-side ingestion
You instrument your app, site, or backend with a Hightouch SDK, the HTTP API, or a streaming source like Kafka or Google Pub/Sub.
